messages:
Samir Patel: Handoff note — I'm taking primary for the 07:00-15:00 UTC shift. There's an active incident (see below) affecting /v1/generate for a small subset of customers. Brief summary: elevated 5xx rate on inference-host-7 after a recent kernel change; mitigation in flight (traffic steering + rollback candidate). I will own paging and initial customer comms. Priority: contain customer impact, avoid noisy restarts, get a clean rollback if safe.

IncidentBot: [ALERT] incident-2026-03-14-01: High 5xx rate detected for model redwood-unified-small on inference-host-7. Triggered by 1839992400. Severity: P1. Pages sent to Samir Patel and rest of oncall.

Jodie Lee: Thanks Samir. I'm secondary for the shift — available for escalations and to take on quick postmortem ownership. Where are you steering traffic to?

Samir Patel: steering to inference-host-3 and host-11 for affected customers via routing policy `regional-failover-v2`. Not touching customers pinned to dedicated pools. Doing gradual 10%->50% over next 10 mins.

Kai Nguyen: Any customer-visible errors? I saw a spike in 502s to a handful of enterprise routes. Which customers?

Samir Patel: yes — three customers saw increased 502/504s (cust-redwood-analytics, cust-lexi, cust-marketplace). Working with acct teams for notifications. Only ~2% of total calls.

Taylor Chen: FYI I opened a ticket for the kernel revert candidate: RD-ISSUE-5821. Patch branch `revert/kernel-select-2026-03-13`. Testing rollback on canary node now.

Samir Patel: good. Do not do full cluster restart. Use gradual revert on canary. If canary looks clean for 5 minutes, we can promote.

IncidentBot: [ACTION] Incident timeline created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/incident-2026-03-14-01

Jodie Lee: Runbook pointer for routing rollback is here: https://redwood.runbooks/traffic-steer-v2 — remember to update `traffic-routing` flag `enable-burst` when doing the steer so we don't spike downstream.

Samir Patel: running health checks against host-3 and host-11 now. Command used: \n```\nrgctl healthcheck --hosts host-3,host-11 --model redwood-unified-small --hist 5m\n```\nHealth looks stable on canary. Latency fine.

Kai Nguyen: logs from host-7 show a kernel OOM pattern during KV cache compaction: `kernel_module: kv_compact(): OOM free_pages failed`. Looks correlated with requests containing long system prompts (~8k tokens).

Samir Patel: noted. I pushed a temporary limit via rate-limit rule `prompt-length-max=6000` for public routes to reduce pressure. Applied at 1839993000.

Taylor Chen: Confirmed RD-ISSUE-5821 has test revert applied to canary; no regressions in unit tests. Running integration tests now (expected ~8m).

Jodie Lee: I'll prepare a short customer comms draft for the three impacted customers. Samir — can you add current status and ETA for resolution?

Samir Patel: ETA: 30-45m depending on canary. Current mitigation: traffic steering to host-3/11 + prompt-length limit. No data loss. Impact: increased 502s for specific enterprise routes, ~2% of calls.

IncidentBot: [UPDATE] paging reminder: oncall rotation note — if you need to hand off before shift end, post a clear Handover summary with open actions.

Samir Patel: Quick handoff plan (in case I need to hand off mid-shift): primary -> Jodie Lee, secondary -> Kai Nguyen. Handoff checklist: 1) confirm canary stability 2) confirm rollback promotion 3) update incident doc with customer list and comms links 4) create postmortem ticket and assign.

Jodie Lee: Acknowledged. If the revert is promoted, I'll follow up with the post-deploy smoke test: `smoke-runner --routes cust-redwood-analytics,cust-lexi,cust-marketplace`.

Kai Nguyen: I'll monitor error budget dashboards and set an alert for >1% 5xx across the region so we catch regressions during promotion.

Taylor Chen: Revert promoted to 20% traffic at 1839993500 to validate wider performance. Rolling increase plan: 20 -> 60 -> 100 over 15 minutes if no regressions.

Samir Patel: saw that. After 5 mins at 20% the 5xx rate went down to baseline on promoted hosts. Proceeding to 60% now.

IncidentBot: [NOTIFICATION] RD-ISSUE-5821 linked to incident-2026-03-14-01. PagerDuty incident: PD-7782.

Jodie Lee: Great. For the post-handoff follow-ups — let's create a dedicated postmortem. Owner: Jodie. Ticket: RD-POSTMORTEM-2026-03-14-01 (assigned to Jodie Lee). Please include root cause, mitigations taken, action items, and timeline.

Samir Patel: I'll file the customer follow-ups as support tickets and cc you, Jodie. Ticket IDs: SUP-90021 (cust-redwood-analytics), SUP-90022 (cust-lexi), SUP-90023 (cust-marketplace).

Kai Nguyen: Action items I own: 1) add stronger OOM safeguards for KV compaction (RD-ARCH-5940), 2) update runtime to fail-fast on extreme prompt lengths (RD-OPT-5941). I'll draft proposals by EOD.

Taylor Chen: Action items I own: 1) create test harness for canary rollback (RD-TEST-5942), 2) add automatic canary promotion safety checks (RD-SAFE-5943). ETA end of week.

Jodie Lee: Scheduling a 45m incident retro tomorrow at 14:00 UTC. Calendar invite to the responder list and product leads. Agenda: timeline, root cause, mitigations, follow-ups.

Samir Patel: handing off primary to Jodie at 1839993800 — I'm stepping out for an urgent meeting but will be reachable on DM for 20m. Handoff summary posted to incident doc.

IncidentBot: [Handoff] Primary changed: Samir Patel -> Jodie Lee at 1839993800.

Jodie Lee: Taking primary. I'll continue the promotion to 100% and confirm once done. Thanks Samir. Please drop any final notes before you go.

Samir Patel: final notes — watch for edge cases with dedicated customer pins, they should not be rerouted. Also verify token-level cost telemetry after revert to ensure there wasn't a stealth token inflation bug.

Jodie Lee: Copy. I'll also ensure postmortem ticket RD-POSTMORTEM-2026-03-14-01 includes an action to add a runbook fragment for `kv_compaction_oom` and a short playbook for prompt-length emergency throttles.

Kai Nguyen: Monitoring dashboards now. Will post an update if anything flares.

IncidentBot: [RESOLVE] Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 1839993950. Customer visible errors returned to baseline for all affected routes.

Jodie Lee: Confirmed — promotion to 100% completed, baseline restored. Closing the live mitigation phase. I'll prepare the postmortem and send invites for the retro.

Samir Patel: thanks all. Action item recap (for the doc):
- Jodie: postmortem & retro, customer comms finalization (RD-POSTMORTEM-2026-03-14-01).
- Kai: architecture fixes proposals (RD-ARCH-5940, RD-OPT-5941).
- Taylor: test harness and safety checks (RD-TEST-5942, RD-SAFE-5943).
- Samir: customer tickets SUP-90021/22/23 and final incident timeline.

Jodie Lee: I'll follow up in the incident doc and mark tasks with owners + due dates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

End of thread.
